Bill Info
LD 819 (HP 526)
"An Act Concerning the Status of Battery Storage Systems with Regard to the Business Equipment Tax Exemption"
Sponsored by Representative Eleanor Sato

Date
Chamber
 Action
2/27/2025 House Received by the Clerk of the House on February 27, 2025.
The Bill was REFERRED to the Committee on TAXATION pursuant to Joint Rule 308.2 and ordered printed pursuant to Joint Rule 401.
3/21/2025 House Carried over, in the same posture, to the next special or regular session of the 132nd Legislature, pursuant to Joint Order SP 519.
6/17/2025 House Reports READ.
On motion of Representative CLOUTIER of Lewiston, the Majority Ought to Pass as Amended Report was ACCEPTED.
The Bill was READ ONCE.
Committee Amendment "A" (H-770) was READ and ADOPTED.
Under suspension of the rules, the Bill was given its SECOND READING without REFERENCE to the Committee on Bills in the Second Reading.
The Bill was PASSED TO BE ENGROSSED as Amended by Committee Amendment "A" (H-770).
Sent for concurrence. ORDERED SENT FORTHWITH.
6/17/2025 Senate Reports Read
On motion by Senator GROHOSKI of Hancock the Majority Ought to Pass as Amended Report ACCEPTED.
Bill READ ONCE
Committee Amendment "A" (H-770) READ and ADOPTED
Under suspension of the Rules, READ A SECOND TIME and PASSED TO BE ENGROSSED AS AMENDED by Committee Amendment "A" (H-770) in concurrence
6/18/2025 House PASSED TO BE ENACTED.
Sent for concurrence. ORDERED SENT FORTHWITH.
6/18/2025 Senate On motion by Senator ROTUNDO of Androscoggin PLACED ON THE SPECIAL APPROPRIATIONS TABLE pending ENACTMENT in concurrence.

PASSED TO BE ENACTED in concurrence.
